segment.source: Renders a quotation beside the portrait of the person who said it, with their name and role set underneath. Use it for: a customer's verdict inside a case study, a founder's comment on an about page, an expert's assessment in a report, a partner statement in a press release. Prefer 'Pull Quote' when the words come from the article's own text, and 'Quote Carousel' when several people should be heard in turn.
